character.name: Zorvath
character.background: Disgraced noble, falsely accused of treason

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: A mote of cold, pale divine fire flares toward a creature within 60 feet. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 radiant damage on a failed save, half as much on a successful one. The flame burns with no warmth, a hollow remnant of his broken bond to the divine.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: You manifest a faint, hollow divine miracle within 30 feet: your voice booms up to three times louder, a candle flame flares, or the ground trembles harmlessly. The magic feels like drawing water from a dry well, a leftover scrap of his former power.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: You touch a living creature and restore 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. The magic flows cold and thin through your hands, a faint echo of the healing power you once wielded as a knight of the realm.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A cracked, darkly glowing spectral shield appears around a creature within 60 feet, granting +2 AC for 1 minute. The shield hums with faint, inert divine energy, a leftover scrap of the oath you were forced to break.

traits: Stoic to a fault, refuses to lie even when deception would save him
Haunted by the guilt of his house's fall, regardless of his innocence
Will not suffer cowards or traitors, and will risk all to clear his name
Keeps a charred fragment of his family seal hidden in his armor at all times
character.gear: Oathbroken longsword · Dented splint armor · Crested steel shield · Charred family seal fragment · Hunting knife · 3 field rations · Brass tinderbox · Healing potion
character.story: Zorvath was a knight of the Silver Flame, sworn to protect the realm, until he was framed for treason by a rival noble who coveted his house’s lands. His ancestral home was burned, his family executed, and his divine oath shattered when the gods turned their backs on him. Now he wanders the blighted borderlands, a fallen knight with nothing left but his sword and his hunger for vengeance. He knows the traitor still wears the stolen title of lord, and he will tear the realm apart to make him pay. The secret he hides: he did not break his oath — dark magic framed him, and the gods abandoned him rather than confront the evil in their own ranks.

inventory.name: Oathbroken Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for his knighting ceremony, the blade’s steel is etched with the faded crest of his disgraced house. The divine runes along its length are cracked and dark, no longer glowing with holy light, a testament to his broken oath.
inventory.description: A longsword once blessed by the church of the Silver Flame, now cracked and dark, its holy magic drained but still sharp.

inventory.name: Dented Splint Armor
inventory.lore: The splint armor he wore as a knight of the realm, dented from the battle where his house fell. The family crest is scratched off the breastplate, a mark of his disgraced status.
inventory.description: Heavy steel splint armor, scarred from battle and marked with the scratches of his disgraced status.

inventory.name: Crested Steel Shield
inventory.lore: A steel shield bearing the faded crest of his house, dented from the same battle that destroyed his name. The divine wards that once protected its bearer are dark and inert.
inventory.description: A heavy steel shield, once blessed with divine wards, now cracked and inert.

inventory.name: Charred Family Seal Fragment
inventory.lore: A small, blackened shard of his family's noble seal, recovered from the ashes of his ancestral home after it was burned for treason. It grows faintly warm when he nears those who betrayed his house.
inventory.description: A tiny, charred fragment of the Ironveil family seal, still bearing the faint outline of a dragon's claw.
inventory.effects: When activated (bonus action), the bearer gains advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to detect lies from those who betrayed his house, and the fragment glows with a faint red light for 1 minute.

inventory.name: Hunting Knife
inventory.lore: A simple steel hunting knife he carried as a youth, still sharp. The handle is wrapped in worn leather from his first hunting trip with his father.
inventory.description: A small, sharp steel hunting knife, well-worn from years of use.

inventory.name: Field Rations
inventory.lore: Dried, salted meat and hard bread, standard issue for realm knights. The wax seal on the wrapping bears the mark of the royal quartermaster, the same one who signed his treason charges.
inventory.description: Standard issue field rations: dried meat, hard bread, and a small portion of preserved fruit.

inventory.name: Brass Tinderbox
inventory.lore: A brass tinderbox he looted from a dead bandit, the flint still sharp. The lid is engraved with a crude dragon, a relic from a previous owner who revered dragonborn knights.
inventory.description: A small brass tinderbox with a sharp flint and a piece of charred cloth for starting fires.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: A small vial of deep red healing draught, given to him by a sympathetic stable hand before he fled the capital. The potion is faintly warm to the touch, the only kindness he's received since his fall.
inventory.description: A small glass vial filled with a deep red, shimmering liquid that smells of honey and herbs.
